description: Fires late in the game right after the opponent plays column 5 while column 5 is still short (usually 2-4 stones) and several other columns are full. Strongest after two or three consecutive column-5 moves, and when the first player moved last. Weak if the last move was elsewhere, early in the game, or column 5 is nearly full. It also depends on move order, not just the board.
effect: None measurable: forcing the unit to its max or to zero moves move probabilities by at most about 4 points on 7 tested positions.
notes: Layer 1, pole -. Hypotheses: last col 5 + late game (F1 0.465), + >=3 full cols (0.492), + recent-5 count (0.471), strict parity (0.402, P 0.74), graded score with col-5 height, parity and full-column count (0.507, best, sim share 0.32), adding recent-5 cases for other last columns (0.422). Minimal pairs agree that a last move in col 5 is needed and that consecutive col-5 moves and full columns raise it. But the same final board reached in different move orders gives 0.3 vs 0.7, so no board-only rule can be exact. The best F1 is only about 0.5 and the misses include lc 0/2/4/6 just after col-5 runs. I used 7 of 8 score calls; one p1 call was accidental. Synthesis 4.27 beats the dev max of 4.0.
